cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Your Turn
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept responsibility for a task you believe should never have been yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take ownership, just as you said. I've written your name on the mop. Bathroom duty was never meant to be mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Taking ownership means doing the job, not owning the mop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, doing it. Your name's right here now. Take it and we'll get your first turn started.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you at least show me the right way?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. You hold the mop while I read the instructions on the bottle. We'll begin with your hands on the job.
